title: 第1章  九帝传功，重塑道基！
content_zh:
“爽了吧？”
山洞之中，篝火燃烧。
女子冷冷的看着方玄，眼中的恨意足以将方玄杀死上百次。
赤身躺在地上的方玄，脑海还有些眩晕。
这在秦洛璃看来，方玄明显就是一脸享受。
他看向眼前的女子，双眼不由得一亮。
女子姿容绝美，如同九天玄女降落凡尘。
胴体诱人，极具魅惑。
只是娇嫩的皮肤上，有着一些清晰的痕迹，青一块紫一块，显示着之前的疯狂与暴烈。
“再看我把你眼珠子挖出来！”
见到方玄盯着自己，秦洛璃差点暴走。
“仙子，你这话就有些不讲道理了。”
方玄无奈道：“明明是你强迫我的......”
“闭嘴！”
秦洛璃冷喝一声，眼中杀意浓烈。
若非那头靡蛟在死前，将一身靡毒打在她身上，需要男子元阳阴阳合和才能解毒。
她堂堂宗门圣女，又岂会被方玄夺走元阴。
而且还是一个毫无修行资质的废物。
如今修为尚未恢复，否则她真想一掌将眼前这个浑蛋拍死。
强忍着被方玄打量的羞愤，秦洛璃快速穿好衣衫。

雪白道袍之上，冰风做展翅翱翔状。
与满身狰狞伤口的方玄，越发显得格格不入。
高傲、冷艳、绝美！
如同一朵高岭之花，美得不可方物。
“收起你那令人恶心的眼神，你已经够令人恶心了！”
秦洛璃随手丢了一瓶丹药给方玄，冷声道：“这是一瓶疗伤灵丹，希望你将此事烂在心里。”
“我要是听到一丝一毫的传言，即便你躲在天涯海角，我必杀你！”
秦洛璃满脸愤怒，强忍剧痛和屈辱，一瘸一拐的朝洞外走去。
“仙子！”
方玄出声，叫住秦洛璃。
“这件事你我都是受害者，但我是个男人，我会对你负责。”
秦洛璃就像是听到世间最好听的笑话，满脸讥讽的说道：“你一个丹田武脉被废的废物，拿什么来负责？”
闻言，方玄不由得一脸苦涩。
他本是先天道体，却因为一场意外，导致修为尽废，甚至因此痴傻了三年，沦为人尽皆知的笑话。
然而，未婚妻苏清瑶，为了谋夺他的道体，竟然联合问道宗弟子赵擎苍，废他丹田，断他武脉，将他打落万丈深渊。
身上的伤，就是证据。
三年的温柔相待，嘘寒问暖，全是虚假的骗局！
目的，仅仅只是等他十六岁之时，可以剥离道体。
苏清瑶，她做到了！
“我送出去的东西，从来没有收回的道理。”

秦洛璃冷冷道：“就当是我玩了你，从此之后，你我各不相欠。”
无论如何，方玄终究救了她一命。
这瓶丹药，就当是还了方玄的人情，斩断这份因果。
她竭力忍受着身体的疼痛，转身离开，背影决绝，像是个高傲的女王。
秦洛璃在洞口顿步，头也不回的说道：“忘记今天所发生的一切，否则，你以及你的家族，都会死得很难看。”
其实以她的眼力，岂会看不出来，就凭方玄现在的状态，不用她出手，也命不久矣。
话落，秦洛璃大步走出山洞。
洞外，一头十几米长的毒蛟趴在地上，气息全无，早已死去。
秦洛璃眼中恨意一闪。
就是这头畜牲，让她蒙受羞辱，失去贞洁。
“嗖嗖嗖！”
就在此时，几道破空声呼啸而至。
就见几名同样身着统一道袍的年轻男女，快速跑来，看到秦洛璃的时候，全都露出激动之色。
“是圣女，她果然在这里！”
“这是......三阶妖兽靡蛟？”
“圣女竟然真的将它杀了！”
众人看到毒蛟的尸体，脸色纷纷剧变，语气中充满了惊叹和钦佩之色。
三阶妖兽，实力相当于凝元境的武者。
但因为妖兽天生体魄强劲，同境武者也很难将其斩杀。
秦洛璃能够将以一己之力，斩杀这头毒蛟，实力着实可怕。

“洛璃，你没事吧？”
为首一名青年，毫不掩饰自己对秦洛璃的爱慕，关心的说道：“我们找了你三天，长老他们都急坏了。”
“我没事，多谢道明师兄关心。”
秦洛璃语气平淡，却带着一丝疏离。
严道明早已习惯，看向秦洛璃身后的山洞中，眉头不由得一皱。
“洛璃，你这几天都在这里吗？”
严道明说道：“我去看看，有没有东西落下。”
秦洛璃说道：“我被这毒蛟所伤，急需回宗门闭关。”
“这么严重?”
严道明一惊，急忙道：“那确实不能耽搁，咱们赶紧回去，也免得长老他们着急。”
说着，严道明挥手间，甩出一艘飞舟。
流云飞舟，飞行法器。
在踏上飞舟之前，严道明对着其中一人使了个眼色，后者心领神会的点点头。
飞舟破空而去，速度快若闪电。
在离开山谷之前，秦洛璃回首望了一眼模糊不清的山洞，眼底闪过一抹复杂。
“流云飞舟？看来，这位洛璃仙子的来头很大啊。”
山洞之中，方玄听到了秦洛璃等人的谈话，也同样看到那破空而去的流云飞舟。
能拥有流云飞舟的宗门，其底蕴深不可测。
而且刚才那几人，明明很年轻，但个个气息雄浑，显然天资不凡。
即便是问道宗，怕也略有不如。

“只可惜.......”
感受着空荡荡的体内，方玄一脸痛苦和黯然。
他明明天资卓绝，如今却沦为废柴。
苏清瑶在夺走他道体的同时，虽然让他神智恢复正常，却也因此断绝了他的武道之路。
丹田武脉道体尽废，除非是大罗神仙出手，否则他此生与武道无缘。
方玄拿起衣服穿上，衣服之中，突然掉落一枚玉佩。
母亲临死前说过，这是父亲留给他的东西，让他好生保管，千万不能丢弃。
他与苏清瑶订下婚约之后，他曾将这枚玉牌送给苏清瑶，当做定情信物。
而苏清瑶将他打落这断魂崖的时候，也顺便将之还给了他。
“就这么一个破烂玩意儿，也配得上我？”
这是苏清瑶的话。
他视若珍宝的东西，在苏清瑶口中，却是个破烂玩意儿。
当真可笑至极。
曾经的真心，就当喂了狗。
轻叹一声，方玄正要将玉佩挂在脖子上。
然而就在方玄触碰到玉佩的时候，异变突生。
一股恐怖的吸力，从玉佩之中传出，开始疯狂的吸收方玄的神魂，还有另外一股力量。
那是秦洛璃留下的元阴！
“咔嚓！”
就在方玄快被吸干的时候，玉佩猛的碎裂开来，九道金光，依次钻入到方玄识海之中。

与此同时，方玄脑海深处突然响起九道震彻寰宇的龙吟！
紧接着，九道璀璨夺目的光影自他神魂深处升腾而起！
“吾乃太初女帝，传你《太初混沌经》，执掌混沌本源，铸不灭道基！”
“吾乃剑墟女帝，传你《万剑归墟诀》，一剑破万法，纵横九重天！”
“吾乃丹鼎女帝，传你《九转丹神录》，炼化天地，丹术通神！”
九道清冷而威严的女声，如惊雷般在方玄神魂中炸响！
父亲留下的玉佩中，竟然封印着九大女帝的残魂！
但其开启条件，却是需要方玄毁去道体，再以女子元阴加上自身神魂方能开启！
九位女帝齐齐玉手结印，施展无上帝术，将各自的毕生绝学，毫无保留地倾囊相授！
断魂崖中，山洞之内。
方玄破碎的眼眸，陡然睁开！
“道体被夺？无妨！”
“武脉尽废？可笑！”
“丹田碎裂？看我——”
方玄嘴角缓缓勾起一抹带着血腥的冷笑。
“重铸无上圣体，执掌九帝神通，镇杀诸天！”
他双腿盘坐，双手结印，演化混沌。
他的识海之中，九尊帝影端坐，各自推演着功法的玄妙，帝威交织，竟在他的神魂深处筑起了一座九层高台，方玄的残魂便端坐于高台之巅，如饥似渴地汲取着无上道则。
“嗡！”
天地震颤，混沌气息绽放。

混沌圣体，成！
方玄缓缓睁开双眼，眸中不再是往日的浑浊痴傻，取而代之的是一片深邃的星空。
九道帝影在眼底沉浮，举手投足间，竟有了一丝睥睨天下的威严。
他抬手，看向自己胸口、丹田。
骨骼断裂处早已愈合如初，甚至比之前更加坚韧，肌肤之下，隐隐有金色的光芒流转。
紧握双拳，混沌流转，圣光绽放。
与此同时，武脉尽开，气血奔腾。
造血一重境！
造血三重境！
造血九重境！
修为如同坐火箭般飙升，仅仅瞬息之间，方玄便跨越了无数武者梦寐以求的境界，直接踏入造血境巅峰！
距离炼体境，仅有一步之遥！
此刻的他，早已不是那个痴傻的废人。九帝传承加身，混沌圣体初成，根基更胜往昔。
但这，并非是他的极限。
只需等稳固圣体，就能继续开发潜力。
“赵擎苍，苏清瑶……”
方玄低声念着这两个名字，眸中杀意翻腾，“你们夺我道体，毁我丹田，断我武脉，此仇不共戴天，必以血洗刷！”
就在此时，一道声音突然响起。
“严师兄果然没猜错，这里面果然有人！”
方玄抬头看去，只见一名尖嘴猴腮的少年，大步走来，看向他的眼神，充满了杀意。

“秦仙子可是严师兄看中的女人，不管你与她什么关系，你都得死！”
方玄皱眉道：“所以，你是来杀我的？”
“不然呢？”
来人冷然一笑：“小子，要怪就怪自己沾染了不该染指的东西吧！”
话音落下，他周身气血沸腾，一拳轰向方玄。
其气息，竟然犹在方玄之上。
显然是一名炼体境的武者！
“杀我？你也配！”
面对对方的一拳，方玄却是嗤笑一声，同样一拳砸了出去。
“原来只是个造血境的废物，死！”
来人一脸讥讽，出拳更快三分。
“咔嚓！”
两拳碰撞，那人却是发出一声凄厉惨叫，手臂扭曲成一个夸张弧度，人也被震飞了出去。
“哇！”
他重重摔落在地，难以置信的看着方玄。
“怎么可能？”
他可是炼体境的武者，对方一个造血境的废物，怎么可能击败自己？
换做旁人自然做不到。
但方玄身怀混沌圣体，获得九帝传承。
若是连一个初入炼体境的武者都胜不了，那也太对不起这份机缘了。

方玄大步走向对方，神情冷漠如冰。
“你......你要做什么？”
那人一脸惊恐，怒声道：“我警告你，我可是.......”
“嘭！”
方玄直接一脚踹爆对方头颅，语气平静的说道：“我可没兴趣知道你是谁。”
杀了此人，方玄看向洞外，眼底爆发出惊天杀意。
“苏清瑶，赵擎苍，很快就轮到你们了！”
content_en:
"Are you feeling good?"
In the cave, a bonfire burned.
The woman looked at Fang Xuan coldly, and the hatred in her eyes was enough to kill Fang Xuan hundreds of times.
Fang Xuan, who was lying naked on the ground, was still a little dizzy.
From Qin Luoli's point of view, Fang Xuan was obviously enjoying himself.
He looked at the woman in front of him, and his eyes couldn't help but light up.
The woman's appearance is exquisite, just like the mysterious goddess from the Nine Heavens descending to the mortal world.
The body is attractive and very charming.
But there are some clear marks on the delicate skin, green and purple, showing the previous madness and violence.
"Watch me pluck out your eyeballs again!"
Seeing Fang Xuan staring at her, Qin Luoli almost ran away.
"Fairy, what you say is a bit unreasonable."
Fang Xuan said helplessly: "You obviously forced me..."
"Shut up!"
Qin Luoli shouted coldly, with murderous intent in his eyes.
If the dragon hadn't hit her with poison before it died, it would have taken a man's Yuanyang and Yin and Yang to combine to detoxify her.
How could she, the majestic saint of the sect, have her Yuan Yin taken away by Fang Xuan?
And he is still a waste with no qualifications for cultivation.
Her cultivation has not yet recovered, otherwise she really wants to slap the bastard in front of her to death with one palm.
Holding back the shame and anger of being looked at by Fang Xuan, Qin Luoli quickly put on her clothes.
On the snow-white robe, the icy wind spreads its wings and soars.
He looked increasingly out of place with Fang Xuan, who was covered in hideous wounds.
Proud, cool and beautiful!
Like a flower on the high mountains, it is incomparably beautiful.
"Stop your disgusting eyes, you are already disgusting enough!"
Qin Luoli threw a bottle of elixir to Fang Xuan and said coldly: "This is a bottle of healing elixir. I hope you will keep this in mind."
"If I hear the slightest rumor, even if you are hiding in the corners of the world, I will kill you!"
Qin Luoli's face was full of anger, she endured the severe pain and humiliation, and limped out of the cave.
"Fairy!"
Fang Xuan spoke up and called Qin Luoli.
"You and I are both victims in this matter, but I am a man and I will be responsible for you."
Qin Luoli seemed to have heard the best joke in the world, and said with a sarcastic face: "You are a loser whose Dantian martial arts have been abolished. How can you be responsible?"
Hearing this, Fang Xuan couldn't help but look bitter.
He was originally an innate Taoist, but due to an accident, his cultivation was completely ruined. He even became an idiot for three years and became a joke to everyone.
However, in order to seize his Taoist body, his fiancée Su Qingyao teamed up with Taoist disciple Zhao Qingcang to destroy his Dantian, cut off his martial arts, and knocked him into the abyss.
The injuries on his body are evidence.
Three years of gentle treatment and asking for help are all a lie!
The purpose is just to wait until he is sixteen years old to be able to peel off his Tao body.
Su Qingyao, she did it!
"There is no reason to take back what I give away."
Qin Luoli said coldly: "Just think that I played a trick on you. From now on, you and I will owe nothing to each other."
In any case, Fang Xuan saved her life after all.
This bottle of elixir is regarded as repaying Fang Xuan's favor and cutting off the cause and effect.
She tried her best to endure the pain in her body, turned around and left, her back resolute, like a proud queen.
Qin Luoli paused at the entrance of the cave and said without looking back: "Forget everything that happened today, otherwise, you and your family will die in an ugly way."
In fact, with her eyesight, how could she not see it? Based on Fang Xuan's current condition, he would not survive long without her taking action.
After saying this, Qin Luoli strode out of the cave.
Outside the cave, a poisonous dragon more than ten meters long was lying on the ground. It had no breath and was already dead.
Qin Luoli's eyes flashed with hatred.
It was this beast that caused her to be humiliated and lose her virginity.
"Swish swish!"
At this moment, several sounds roared through the air.
Several young men and women, also wearing uniform Taoist robes, were seen running over quickly. When they saw Qin Luoli, they all showed excitement."It's the saint, she is indeed here!"
"This is...the third-order monster Mijiao?"
"The saint actually killed it!"
When everyone saw the poisonous dragon's corpse, their expressions changed dramatically, and their voices were filled with wonder and admiration.
A third-level monster whose strength is equivalent to that of a warrior in the Condensation Realm.
However, because the monster beast is naturally strong, it is difficult for warriors from the same realm to kill it.
Qin Luoli was able to kill this poisonous dragon with his own strength, and his strength was truly terrifying.
"Luo Li, are you okay?"
The leader, a young man, made no secret of his admiration for Qin Luoli and said with concern: "We have been looking for you for three days, and the elders and the others are very anxious."
"I'm fine, thank you Brother Daoming for your concern."
Qin Luoli's tone was calm, but with a hint of alienation.
Yan Daoming had long been used to it. Looking at the cave behind Qin Luoli, he couldn't help but frown.
"Luo Li, have you been here these days?"
Yan Daoming said: "I'm going to see if anything fell."
Qin Luoli said: "I was injured by this poisonous dragon and I urgently need to return to the sect for retreat."
"So serious?"
Yan Daoming was startled and said hurriedly: "There really can't be any delay. Let's go back quickly so that the elders and others won't be anxious."
With that said, Yan Daoming waved his hand and launched a flying boat.
Flowing clouds and flying boats, flying magic weapons.
Before stepping onto the flying boat, Yan Daoming winked at one of them, who nodded understandingly.
The flying boat flew through the air as fast as lightning.
Before leaving the valley, Qin Luoli looked back at the blurry cave, with a flash of complexity in her eyes.
"Liu Yun Feizhou? It seems that Fairy Luo Li has a great background."
In the cave, Fang Xuan heard the conversation of Qin Luoli and others, and also saw the Liuyun Feizhou flying through the air.
A sect that can own floating clouds and flying boats has an unfathomable background.
Moreover, those people just now were obviously very young, but they all had strong auras and were obviously very talented.
Even if he is a Taoist sect, I am afraid he is not as good as him.
"It's a pity..."
Feeling the emptiness in his body, Fang Xuan looked pained and dejected.
He was obviously very talented, but now he was reduced to useless.
When Su Qingyao took away his Tao body, although he restored his sanity to normal, it also cut off his path to martial arts.
The martial arts in his Dantian were completely destroyed. Unless Daluo Immortal took action, he would have no chance of martial arts in this life.
Fang Xuan picked up his clothes and put them on. Suddenly, a jade pendant fell from his clothes.
Before his death, his mother said that this was something his father left to him, and asked him to keep it well and never throw it away.
After he and Su Qingyao entered into an engagement, he gave this jade plaque to Su Qingyao as a token of love.
When Su Qingyao knocked him off the soul-breaking cliff, she also returned it to him.
"Is such a piece of junk worthy of me?"
These are Su Qingyao's words.
What he regarded as a treasure was a junk to Su Qingyao.
It's really ridiculous.
The sincerity you once had is just like feeding a dog.
With a sigh, Fang Xuan was about to hang the jade pendant around his neck.
However, when Fang Xuan touched the jade pendant, something changed suddenly.
A terrifying suction force came from the jade pendant, and began to absorb Fang Xuan's soul crazily, as well as another force.
That is the Yuan Yin left by Qin Luoli!
"Crack!"
Just when Fang Xuan was about to be sucked dry, the jade pendant suddenly shattered into pieces, and nine rays of golden light penetrated into Fang Xuan's sea of consciousness one after another.
At the same time, nine dragon roars that shook the world suddenly sounded in the depths of Fang Xuan's mind!
Immediately afterwards, nine dazzling lights and shadows rose from the depths of his soul!
"I am the Empress of Taichu, and I will teach you the Taichu Chaos Sutra. I will control the origin of chaos and forge the foundation of immortality!"
"I am the Empress of Jianxu, and I will teach you the Art of Returning Ten Thousand Swords to Ruxu. With one sword, you can defeat all kinds of magic and traverse the nine heavens!"
"I am the Empress of the Alchemy Cauldron, and I will teach you the "Nine Transformations of the Alchemy God"》, refining the heaven and earth, using alchemy to connect the gods! "
Nine cold and majestic female voices exploded in Fang Xuan's soul like thunder!
The jade pendant left by his father actually contained the remaining souls of the nine empresses!
But the conditions for its activation are that Fang Xuan needs to destroy his Tao body, and then use the woman's Yuan Yin plus his own soul to activate it!
The nine empresses formed a seal with their jade hands, performed the Godless Art, and taught each other their lifelong secrets without reservation!
In the soul-breaking cliff, inside the cave.
Fang Xuan's broken eyes suddenly opened!
"Tao body was taken away? No problem! "
"The martial arts are all gone? ridiculous! "
"The dantian is broken? Look at me—"
The corner of Fang Xuan's mouth slowly raised into a bloody sneer.
"Recast the supreme holy body, control the magical powers of the Nine Emperors, and suppress the heavens! "
He sat cross-legged and formed a seal with his hands, evolving into chaos.
In his sea of consciousness, nine imperial figures sat upright, each deducing the mystery of the technique. The imperial power intertwined and actually built a nine-story high platform in the depths of his soul. Fang Xuan's remnant soul sat on the top of the high platform, eagerly absorbing the supreme principles.
